However: cuBLAS handles are captured once and replayed; per-call workload-adaptive routing (e.g., different actuator for different batch sizes) requires graph-capture-time substrate-aware substitution OR graph-replay-time intercept (cuGraphAddKernelNode + cuGraphLaunch wrappers from B.6''.9.8).

goal_3_mfu_sm_packer.production_impact: MFU + SM packer observation/decision pipeline operates on stale capture-time data during replay. Per-launch SM-packing decisions can't fire during the 96% replay-blind window.

goal_4_koopman.production_impact: Capture-time Koopman substitution OK if substitution decision is workload-stable; per-token Koopman O(1) substitution needs graph-aware intercepts
